pm.assumption: 10 s broad reference, zero residual and bias, assumed particle constants; best nuisance adjustment allowed
pm.implication: Additional constraints can supply information, but improvement supplied by external mass observations is not THz retrieval

radio.band_selection: 71-76 GHz space-to-Earth reference; no licensing or coordination determination
radio.decision: Communication engineering reference retained; current E-band joint VOC/PM sensing rejected
radio.hardware_reference: VDI WR12 VNA extenders cover 60-90 GHz; laboratory measurement equipment, not a flight modem
radio.hardware_spec_scope: Typical WR12 values; one hour after warm-up with ideal cables and stable laboratory environment; not a measured stochastic covariance
radio.limits_scope: Separate one-impairment-at-a-time conditional limits, not a jointly allocated error budget
radio.waveform_scope: Uncoded QPSK control; Shannon rate is separate and not demonstrated modem throughput
remaining: Acquisition/phase tracking during a real pass
